howItWorks.title: Go live in
howItWorks.description: From account creation to your first automated booking — we guide you through every step.

steps.title: Create Your Account
steps.desc: Sign up in under 60 seconds. Enter your business name, category, and city.
steps.detail: Your account is created instantly. The system guides you through a simple 5-step onboarding flow.

steps.title: Verify Your Identity (KYC)
steps.desc: Upload your national ID card (front & back) and record a 5-second selfie video.
steps.detail: Our team reviews your documents within 24 hours. You get an email the moment your account is activated.

steps.title: Build Your Business Profile
steps.desc: Choose a theme for your category, add your services with prices, and upload your gallery.
steps.detail: Your profile becomes your public booking page — shareable on WhatsApp, Instagram, and everywhere.

steps.title: Configure Your Operations
steps.desc: Set your working hours, breaks, rest intervals between appointments, and daily capacity.
steps.detail: Invite your staff via secure links. Each member gets role-based access and their own schedule.

steps.title: Share Your Booking Link
steps.desc: Share your unique Bookiify link on WhatsApp status, Instagram bio, Google Maps, or your website.
steps.detail: Clients book 24/7 without creating an account. You get instant notifications for every new booking.

steps.title: Manage & Grow Automatically
steps.desc: Reminders are sent, invoices generated, loyalty points awarded — all automatically.
steps.detail: Use the AI assistant and analytics to spot patterns and keep growing. Your business runs on autopilot.

faq.q: How long does KYC verification take?
faq.a: Our team reviews identity documents within 24 hours. You receive an email notification the moment your account is activated.

faq.q: Can customers book without creating an account?
faq.a: Yes. Bookiify is completely account-free for end customers. They visit your link, pick a service, choose a time, and confirm — no passwords, no app to download.

faq.q: What happens when a booking is cancelled?
faq.a: If the Smart Waitlist is enabled, the next eligible client is automatically offered the freed slot via a timed email invitation with a secure one-time link.

faq.q: Can I manage multiple staff members?
faq.a: Yes. You can invite unlimited staff with different roles — Manager, Receptionist, or Staff. Each gets a secure login link and role-appropriate dashboard access.
Currently Bookiify is focused on the Tunisian market with local city support and Tunisian payment integration. International expansion is on our roadmap.

dashboardLayout.faqGs1Q: How do I verify my identity (KYC)?
dashboardLayout.faqGs1A: Click 'GET VERIFIED' in the sidebar. Upload a clear photo of your ID card (front and back), then complete the 5-second biometric scan. Our team reviews your dossier within 24 hours and notifies you by email.
dashboardLayout.faqGs2Q: How do I set up my online booking page?
dashboardLayout.faqGs2A: Go to Website in the sidebar, choose a theme, add your services with prices and durations, set your opening hours, and publish. You'll get a unique link to share with customers on WhatsApp, Instagram, or your website.
dashboardLayout.faqGs3A: Work Mode is a simplified daily interface. Track today's queue, mark appointments as done, manage walk-ins, and let staff log in via a secure invite link — all optimized for phone use at your business.
dashboardLayout.faqBk1Q: How do customers book with me?
dashboardLayout.faqBk1A: Share your Bookiify link. Customers choose a service, pick an available time slot, and confirm. You get an instant notification and the booking appears in Appointments.
dashboardLayout.faqBk2Q: How do I confirm or cancel a booking?
dashboardLayout.faqBk2A: In Appointments, click any booking to open its details. Use the action buttons to Confirm, Reschedule, or Cancel. The customer automatically receives an email notification.
dashboardLayout.faqBk3Q: Can I block time off / set my schedule?
dashboardLayout.faqBk3A: Yes. In your settings you can define working days and hours, add breaks, and block specific dates for holidays or personal time.
dashboardLayout.faqFi1Q: How do I track my revenue?
dashboardLayout.faqFi1A: The Finance page shows earnings by day, week, or month. Filter by service type or staff member. All transactions are logged automatically when a booking is completed.
dashboardLayout.faqFi2Q: How do I send an invoice?
dashboardLayout.faqFi2A: In Invoices, click 'New Invoice', select the customer and services, then hit Send. The invoice is emailed as a PDF with your business branding and a payment reference.
dashboardLayout.faqFi3Q: How does the loyalty program work?
dashboardLayout.faqFi3A: Customers earn points per visit or total spend. In Loyalty settings, define your point-to-reward rules. Customers can redeem points for free services or discounts on their next booking.
dashboardLayout.faqSe1Q: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
dashboardLayout.faqSe1A: Settings → Security → Enable Two-Factor Auth. Scan the QR code with Google Authenticator or Authy. From then on, every login requires your 6-digit app code after your password.
dashboardLayout.faqSe2Q: How do I change my password?
dashboardLayout.faqSe2A: Settings → Security → Change Password. Enter your current password then choose a new strong password (min 8 characters, must include uppercase, a number, and a special character).
dashboardLayout.faqSe3A: Bookiify ties your session to the device you logged in from. If someone steals your token and tries to use it from a different device, the session is rejected automatically.
